Single-valued, 0 nulls, form present -- A CONSTANT DOES THAT. Holds while the output moves -- A CONSTANT DOES THAT TOO, because a constant holds while ANYTHING moves. declared_exclusions.item: The order-dependence of the LOADER (as distinct from the digest form)
declared_exclusions.reason: Named as the limit in V-3 and deliberately not chased. The form is over the LOADED substrate; if `_load_ddb` itself ever merged or dropped items differently per run, the digest would move for a reason outside this form. V-2's arm (i) catches that, and the cause would then be the loader's and routed separately. Measuring it now would require a second instrument on a component nothing has shown to be faulty -- the frozen-substrate design already separates the two, so the attribution is available if it ever fires.

declared_exclusions.item: The six other digest-bearing fields found by the V-2(iv) census
declared_exclusions.reason: All six were classified against arm (i) and NONE failed, so there is nothing to route: content_hash and the form constants are deterministic by construction; gross_leg_vintage is a module-level literal; vintage_quality already declares its own non-reproducibility as a claim string; desc_hash's underlying key is hashlib.md5 rather than Python's per-process hash(). Recorded as an exclusion rather than silence so a future reader knows the census was RUN and returned clean, not that it was skipped.

surprises: OBSERVATION x DISARMED (owner: 2.0.0_SA_COO as issuer; disarmed same-turn by the issuer's own [SYNC] correction). The issuer's 87999 stated the g-13 bytes would deploy at a LATER window; the measured served ETag showed them ALREADY on the key at 14:42:52Z, matching the index blob at 1befd43cef. Surfaced with the measurement rather than assumed either way, and the issuer corrected the clause. The general shape is worth the record: a deploy state stated in a message is a CLAIM, and the object is the only thing that settles it -- had the message been believed, V-4's ledger would have been opened against the wrong window and Monday's fire attributed to the wrong bytes.

OBSERVATION x INERT (owner: this seat, carried forward from C02-g-10 and NOT re-chased here). `vintage_quality` at perfrp_emit_core.py:715 already carries exactly the claim-field pattern this cell installs -- it declares itself 'read-time-only; no vintage store (contract: STRUCTURALLY-ABSENT)'. Two independent arrivals at the same convention, from different seats and different rounds, is a signal the convention is the right one; it is recorded so the g-13 form is not later described as novel when the estate already had a precedent.

compiler_tools.tool: the frozen-substrate digest harness (purpose-built for this cell)
compiler_tools.invocation: one DDB materialisation pickled to a snapshot, then N separate processes digesting THAT snapshot under both the legacy and the canon form, at explicit and default hash seeds
compiler_tools.result: The instrument that made the whole cell attributable. Freezing the substrate removed the loader as a confound BEFORE any claim was made about the form -- which is exactly the limit V-3 names, closed by construction rather than by a sentence. It also produced the measured detail that only 6 of 9,538 tickers carry a set-valued attribute: a cause that small randomised an entire served field, and a sampling census would have missed it.

compiler_tools.invocation: ast.walk over Assign->Subscript and Dict keys matching (vintage|hash|digest|sha256|checksum) across {a,b,c}0*.py + runner_common + perfrp_* + the chain entrypoint
compiler_tools.result: 8 fields over 34 modules, all classified, zero findings to route. Chosen after comp-find on the same tokens returned 1,801 hits across 73 pages dominated by CONFIG data files -- a text sweep answers 'where does this word appear', not 'what fields does this code emit', and its page 1 is not an answer.

compiler_tools.tool: the real a07 code path, run three times ad-hoc to scratch roots
compiler_tools.result: Confirmed the harness result on the actual producer: one vintage across three processes, content_hash unchanged, and the new column present on both tables. A harness that agrees with itself is not evidence; a harness that agrees with the live path is.

compiler_tools.invocation: served ETag vs md5 of the index blob at the pinned commit
compiler_tools.result: Established that the g-13 bytes were ALREADY served at 14:42:52Z, correcting a standing expectation in the issuer's own message. Deployed state is a property of the object, never of the sentence describing it.

compiler_tools.result: Turned V-3's distinguishability from an assertion into a measurement: 1,080 stored partitions counted rather than quoted, and the form field read ABSENT on 4 of 4 probes.
